verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal's docs list official SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native, alongside an API-based integration. There is a public GitHub repo for the Terminal JS SDK, a version 5.0.0 SDK migration guide, and a built-in simulated reader for testing SDK integrations without hardware. A community post praises deep API-level integration but says nothing hands-on about the SDKs themselves, so missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and evidence on server-side SDK language coverage.
